purpose: Portable deterministic graph workload for backend and Rust rewrite comparisons.

graph_contract.each_write: atomically append one canonical Kogwistar Node event and one Edge event linking the previous node to the new node; replace both graph projections in the same SQLite transaction
graph_contract.grounding: each node and edge has a source span whose excerpt exactly matches the immutable deterministic source text

embedding.vector_source: SHAKE256-seeded deterministic vectors stored in the fixture
embedding.encoding: little-endian uint32 samples mapped to [-1,1], L2-normalized, rounded to IEEE-754 float32

backend_matrix.sqlite_event_projection: SQLite authoritative graph events and projections; no vector index
backend_matrix.chroma_sqlite_metadata: Chroma PersistentClient vector collection with SQLite metadata; Kogwistar graph events/projections remain in SQLite
backend_matrix.postgres_pgvector: PostgreSQL/pgvector semantic index; Kogwistar graph events/projections remain in SQLite

read_after_write.write_atomicity: one Node+Edge bundle and both named projections per transaction
read_after_write.visibility: both reads must observe and validate the just-committed node, edge, endpoints, and source grounding

mixes.balanced: four graph reads per individually committed node+edge write; two readers observe before commit and two after commit
mixes.read_heavy: eight graph reads per individually committed node+edge write; all readers observe both before and after commit

concurrent.visibility: pre-commit reads observe the prior committed graph head; post-commit reads observe the new head and validate its edge event and endpoints

service_mode_scope.rust_native_jsonrpc_http_benchmark_slice: benchmark-only vertical slice implementing identical deterministic graph tool request/response operations; not the production Kogwistar MCP server
service_mode_scope.embedding_inference: excluded from timed sections; graph fixture carries precomputed vectors for backend runs

metrics: SQLite database and vector index footprint
errors and exact final graph-state digest

acceptance: all configurations consume the same versioned trace
node and edge events and projections are equivalent across implementations
read-after-write and concurrent visibility match the declared trace
backend restart/reopen preserves the expected graph and vector state
requested backends cannot be silently skipped
two fixture sizes and at least five fresh samples per configuration are reported
